questions.question: In 'def send(msg, priority=1):', what is 'priority=1'?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! If priority is omitted in the call, it defaults to 1.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Parameters with = value in the header are default parameters.

questions.question: Can default parameters be placed BEFORE non-default parameters in the function definition?
options: No, non-default parameters must always come first
questions.correct_answer: No, non-default parameters must always come first
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Non-default parameters must precede parameters with defaults.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Python syntax requires required parameters to come before optional defaults.

questions.question:
What is the output of:
def discount(price, rate=10):
    return price - rate
print(discount(100))
questions.explanation_incorrect: The default rate of 10 is subtracted from 100 to yield 90.

questions.question: What is the output of discount(100, 25) using the same function above?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Passing 25 overrides the default rate of 10, computing 100 - 25 = 75.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Passing 25 explicitly overrides the default 10, giving 100 - 25 = 75.
